---
name: optimize-frontend
description: Identify and implement evidence-based frontend performance improvements.
agent: agent
---

Improve performance for the specified route or component.

- Inspect architecture, client/server boundaries, dependencies, images, fonts, and data loading.
- Use available measurements or build evidence first; do not guess at bottlenecks.
- Prioritize high-impact, low-risk changes.
- Avoid new dependencies unless justified.
- Preserve accessibility and existing behavior.
- Run relevant checks and compare measurements if available.

Report evidence, changes, files, checks, and trade-offs. Do not claim measured gains without before/after measurements.
